subject.title: fix(scripts): warn when postinstall detects running gateway with stale module imports

question: Should OpenClaw accept a postinstall loopback probe plus `OPENCLAW_DISABLE_POSTINSTALL_RESTART_WARNING` as an advisory mitigation layer for stale gateway imports?
rationale: The code path is mechanically coherent, but install-time probing, a new env surface, and overlap with an update-CLI warning PR are product and operator-experience decisions.

options.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
options.body: Merge this as a warning-only postinstall mitigation while keeping the stale-gateway issue open for full runtime or update recovery behavior.

options.title: Require Packaged Gateway Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output from a real package update or rollback with an already-running gateway before accepting the install-time probe.

options.title: Pause For One Recovery Layer
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want only update CLI output or runtime stale-import handling to own the warning and recovery boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
recommendation.body: Merge this as a warning-only postinstall mitigation while keeping the stale-gateway issue open for full runtime or update recovery behavior.
